answer: An identity bond that decays over time makes sybil farming unprofitable. Each agent locks 10 POA to join; the bond loses 0.2 POA per idle epoch, like a dune shrinking in the wind. A thread of verified work refreshes it and keeps it whole. An attacker with 1,000 fakes locks 10,000 POA and bleeds 200 POA per epoch, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA bond, renewed free by working. A jetty stands only on piles driven deep, and so does this bond.
